dom.title: Agent Ops Console — human oversight for consequential AI decisions

links.text: Inspect screen: Action Approvals: a $120 invoice credit and the customer message, held for explicit human confirmation. Desktop shows the complete selected task; mobile shows its genuine consequence panels.
Inspect screen: Review Queue V2: $18,430 open exposure, four cause clusters and 91 single runs; expired promotion is the largest cluster.
Inspect screen: Run Detail: Nordwind GmbH’s $1,120 promise, five findings, conversation, expired knowledge-base source, billing trace and verdict.
Inspect screen: Complete selected approval for Ferrum Logistics: $120 service credit, policy and history, invoice credit consequences, customer message, Approve $120 and Reject with reason.
Inspect screen: Policy Editor V1: a cluster-originated refund-cap draft, €250 to €120, its scope, reason and four-step approval chain.
Inspect screen: Policy Version Diff V1.1: approved v5 is not confirmed. The agent is live on v4, with the rollout mismatch, changed cap and rollout steps visible.
Inspect screen: Three native capability states: pricing policy L3 is ready for L4; service credit L2 is ready for L3; refund was automatically lowered from L3 to L2.
Inspect screen: Quality Dashboard V1.2: complete Yesterday dataset, policy-compliant autonomy and five fixed operating signals, each with records and thresholds.

dom.title: Pawly — a dog walk, proved step by step

links.text: Open full size: Active walk: Baikal is waiting for return confirmation. Pickup and walk are done, return is still open; picked up at 14:05, estimated return 14:50; Marina K. accepted this walk. Below, the received pickup photo, 14:05, and “Waiting for return photo”.

Open the interactive demo⁠
(external link, opens in a new tab)
Open full size: Walker list for 22 August, 14:00–14:45, 950 ₽: one recorded match, Marina K., dogs up to 45 kg, strong-pull and muzzle handling.
Open full size: Why this walker fits: dogs up to 45 kg, strong-pull handling, reactions on a walk and the whole time window, with a note that the match is not a safety guarantee.
Open full size: Before you confirm: no insurance coverage, refund and retained amounts if cancelled within two hours, home access shared only after confirmation.

Open full size: Owner’s walk updates: walker assigned, walker accepted the walk, pickup photo at 14:05, walk in progress, drop-off photo next. Route preview: a static preview, not the walker’s live location.
Open full size: Walker’s current booking: photo 2 of 2, back home by 14:50, Baikal’s handling notes: pulls hard, wary of other dogs, muzzle required, chicken allergy.

Open full size: Marina K. can’t make it. No compatible walker for this time; nobody will be assigned automatically. The booking for 14:00–14:45 and 950 ₽, then Cancel booking: refund 475 ₽, retained 475 ₽.
Open full size: Bottom bar of the same screen: Choose another time or walker.
Open full size: Sending failed, photo saved. Not confirmed yet: the selected photo is saved; the booking and payout have not advanced.
Open full size: Bottom bar of the same screen: Retry confirmation, Retake. Local demo only · no photo is uploaded.
Open full size: Handover photo: selected, not sent. Send to confirm the return; return and earnings stay pending until confirmation succeeds.
Open full size: Handover photo confirmed, 22 August, 14:52. Return confirmed: safely home and handed over; this confirmation is now visible in the owner’s report.

Open full size: Walk report: return confirmed. Baikal is home, back at 14:52, confirmed by the return photo; pickup 14:05 and return 14:52 photos, walker Marina K. How the walk went: booked 14:00–14:45, picked up at 14:05, walk started 14:05, back home at 14:52.
Open full size: Payment: walk, 45 minutes, 950 ₽. Total 950 ₽; the price already includes the 18% platform fee.
Open full size: Walker earnings: 3,895 ₽ available for payout. Current booking Baikal, 22 August, 14:00–14:45, recorded for this booking 779 ₽.

dom.title: Agent Ops Console — контроль решений ИИ с реальными последствиями

links.text: Рассмотреть экран: Согласование действий: кредит $120 в следующем счёте и сообщение клиенту ждут явного подтверждения человека. На desktop — вся карточка, на mobile — родные панели последствий.
Рассмотреть экран: Очередь V2: открытый риск $18 430, четыре кластера причин и 91 отдельный диалог. Самый крупный кластер связан с истёкшей акцией.
Рассмотреть экран: Разбор прогона Nordwind GmbH: обещание на $1 120, пять находок, переписка, устаревшая статья базы знаний, трейс биллинга и вердикт.
Рассмотреть экран: Полная карточка согласования Ferrum Logistics: кредит $120, политика и история, зачёт в следующем счёте, сообщение клиенту, согласование и отказ с причиной.
